checks.description: All checks resolved this turn, batched into a single emission (emit-event dedupes by topic per turn, so one event must carry every check).

action.description: Short description of the attempted risky action, as it appears in the narrative.

attribute.description: Character attribute the modifier was derived from, if any.

roll.description: The consumed pre-rolled d20 value, unmodified.

modifier.description: Attribute modifier added to the roll.

dc.description: Difficulty class the total was compared against.

difficulty.description: Named difficulty band (easy 8 / normal 12 / hard 16 / extreme 20).

outcome.description: Resolved outcome. Natural 20 = critical-success, natural 1 = critical-failure.
